create_TrackerPredictor: create a TrackerPredictor instance for video object tracking with coarse and fine prediction stages
run_TrackerPredictor_forward: run TrackerPredictor forward pass to track query points across video frames and return predicted tracks
build_process_images_to_fmaps: build feature maps from input images using TrackerPredictor's coarse feature network
test_coarse_prediction: test coarse tracking prediction with configurable iterations and down-sampling ratio
refine_fine_tracking: refine coarse track predictions with fine-level tracking using ShallowEncoder and fine predictor
